description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Beseech the Queen by paying {2/B}{2/B}{2/B}, searching your library for Seasons Past and put into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Beseech the Queen and Capture of Jingzhou to your hand and putting Seasons Past to the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
